parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift`. The two methods — `ArtworkServiceTests.doesNotCacheServerErrors` (line 442) and `ArtworkServiceTests.doesNotCacheTransientErrors` (line 563) — are near-duplicate test cases (Jaccard 0.71) that intentionally exercise distinct error categories (server errors vs. transient errors). While structural similarity is high, collapsing them would obscure the semantic distinction between the two error scenarios and reduce test clarity. Per the decision rules, all-test clusters are treated as intentional duplication.
